children: Bank of Canada research issued Monday points to further rate hikes ahead from the central bank, says the fixed-income team at CIBC Capital Markets. The analysis, written by advisor to the governor Stephen Murchison, argues that it's better for central banks to act early in response to a supply shock, as officials don't know at the moment how long and persistent the shock might be. CIBC strategists say they believe the BOC paper was an effort "to explain what it has done and what it is going to do again and why." Based on the parameters of the BOC research, CIBC advises clients the central bank's policy rate might climb by another 0.75 percentage points. (paul.vieira@wsj.com; @paulvieira)
